documents.name: WEBINAR - Fundamentals and Degradation Pathways of Lithium-Ion Batteries (YouTube)
documents.description: This session provides a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental working principles and degradation pathways of Lithium-ion batteries. It covers the electrochemical basics of battery operation, key aging mechanisms affecting performance and safety, and advanced spectroscopy tools used to analyze material degradation. The discussion further explores real-world applications and outlines future research directions for enhancing battery lifespan, reliability, and safety in electric vehicles and energy storage systems.
